messages:
sahil: Hey @jordan @maya @alex — can I get runtime + infra + security eyes on PR #17822? It changes kv-eviction heuristics and adds optional KMS rotation support. Planning a small canary tomorrow morning. https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/17822

jordan: can you paste the perf numbers (p95/p99) from your runs? worried about tail latency impact.

sahil: short numbers from our staging run (single node): baseline (main) p95=34ms p99=110ms; branch w/ eviction p95=36ms p99=125ms. run command used:```./scripts/run_latency.sh --model gpt-medium --qps 20 --duration 10m``` full artifacts: https://ci.redwood/infer/17822/artifacts

maya: security quick check: KMS rotation code looks small but we need the KMS policy diff and a mapping of key IDs for customers who opt in. also add an e2e test that demonstrates fallback to previous key. otherwise i can't +1 yet.

alex: infra note: default for the eviction flag should stay false for Dedicated clusters. please add a config toggle and document the rollout plan. i'll take the infra review and can respond in ~2h.

sahil: ack. added config snippet to the branch:```yaml
runtime:
  kv_eviction:
    enabled: false # default
    threshold_ms: 1200
kms:
  rotation_enabled: true
  key_alias: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01
```

jordan: runtime comment: can we gate the eviction path behind a feature flag first so we can roll back quickly if p99 drifts? also left an inline comment re: potential KV invalidation race. i'll do a full review in ~1.5h.

maya: tagging @ops-security FYI — touches key rotation and customer key metadata.

infra-bot: merge-queue update: PR 17822 enqueued for canary; estimated canary window 08:00 PDT tomorrow.

sahil: thanks — plan is to canary at 08:00 PDT for ~30m with the feature flag off by default. @jordan @maya @alex please reply with approve/hold so I can proceed with scheduling. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jordan: approve (pending my inline fix for the race). i'll post a follow-up comment with a small test snippet.

maya: hold until KMS policy doc is uploaded (need to review principal/table mapping).

alex: infra approve — no infra blockers from my side.

sahil: uploaded KMS policy doc: https://docs.redwood/internal/kms/policy-17822.md — pinging again for security.

maya: approve — policy looks fine, added one small nit about logging.

sahil: thanks everyone. scheduling canary for 08:00 PDT and will tag owners in the rollout notes. will update thread after canary completes. :white_check_mark:
